Description: Keep QSS in one .qss file applied app-wide
Do: Load a single .qss via app.setStyleSheet and theme tokens
Don't: Set setStyleSheet on many individual widgets
Style by deep widget paths that break on refactor
Expect the whole widget to inherit one rule

Description: QSS alone leaves some native bits light
Do: Set a dark QPalette AND QSS before show() to avoid flashes
Don't: Apply only QSS for dark mode

Do: Generate QSS from a token dict (one source of truth)
Don't: Hardcode the same hex in 30 rules

Description: QSS padding/border differ from CSS on some widgets
Do: Test padding/margin per widget; set min-height for buttons

Description: QSS image refs need valid paths
Do: Use qrc:/ or url(:/icons/x.svg) via Qt resource system
Ship SVG icons or @2x PNG via resource system
Don't: Ship one 16px PNG for all DPIs
